definitions: A broad class of antibiotics, consisting of all antibiotic agents that contain a beta-lactam ring in their molecular structure.
They are the most widely used group of antibiotics and include penicillins, cephalosporins, carbapenems, and monobactams.
examples: Beta-lactam antibiotics are crucial in treating bacterial infections.
Resistance to beta-lactam antibiotics is a growing concern.
The doctor prescribed beta-lactam antibiotics for the pneumonia.
